name: Briscola a 31
description: Briscola a 31 is a fast two-player variant of the Italian trick-taking game Briscola, played with a standard 52-card deck using Briscola card values. Players capture tricks and count card points, and the hand ends as soon as someone claims to have at least 31 points in their won tricks.

history.origins: Briscola a 31 is a quick two-player Italian variant of Briscola, described by Paolo Ronzoni. It keeps the standard Briscola card ranking and point values but changes the goal: play continues until a player claims to have 31 or more points in their tricks, winning if the claim is correct and losing if it is not.

scoring.description: Card points are counted using Briscola values (Ace 11, Three 10, King 4, Queen 3, Jack 2; others 0). In Briscola a 31, play stops as soon as a player claims to have at least 31 points in their tricks; if the claim is correct they win, and if it is incorrect the opponent wins the hand.
scoring.winCondition: First player to correctly claim 31 or more card points in their tricks wins the hand; an incorrect claim immediately gives the win to the opponent.
